I HEARD HE WAS STILL AT THE FRONT.. SO WHY?
WHAT HAPPENED TO YOU? YOU SEEM TO BE LIMPING
YES. I WAS WOUNDED IN BATTL...
WELL, I EXPECT I'LL BE LIKE THIS FOR A WHILE.
THE FACE OF THE MAN I HAD RESENTED..
APPEARED IN A TINY CORNER OF THE NEWSPAPER.
WHEN I FIRST RAN AWAY FROM HOME,
I HELD ON TO THE FAINT HOPE THAT HE'D COME LOOKING FOR ME.
I DON'T THINK THAT HOPE WAS ENTIRELY UNFOUNDED.
SURE, HE SAW ME AS NOTHING BUT A TOOL TO RESTORE THE FAMILY'S FORTUNES.
I WAS THE ONE RESPONSIBLE FOR MY MOTHER'S DEATH.
AS MUCH AS I RESENTED HIM...
PART OF ME STILL HOPED HE FELT SOME AFFECTION FOR ME.
IT WAS ALL JUST WISHFUL THINKING.
NOW, THE MAN I RESENTED WAS GONE
ALL THAT WAS LEFT WAS ME, A COWARD WHO.
... WAS USING HIS FATHER'S DEATH AS AN EXCUSE TO RETURN HOME.
I HADN'T BEEN TO MY HOMETOWN.
WE HAVE ARRIVED AT OUR DESTINATION WIBIN.
EVEN AFTER TEN YEARS, NOTHING HAD CHANGED.
